info.title: verification
info.description: The verification API defines endpoints for initiating, confirming, and fetching details  of micro deposit transactions to verify bank accounts in the US and Canada.

post.description: This endpoint is used to intiate the micro deposit transaction. The bank routing information required will vary depending on the country. Currently only US and Canada are supported.

Country.description: Country for which the Micro Transaction should be initiated

CompanyName.description: Company name of the account holder - required for associating the bank details

FirstName.description: First name of the account holder - required for associating the bank details (optional if company name is present)

LastName.description: Last name of the account holder - required for associating the bank details (optional if company name is present)

Notes.description: An optional note to associate with the account verification request.

InstitutionNumber.description: Financial Institution number - required for associating the bank details. Canada only.

TransitNumber.description: Bank transit number - required for associating the bank details. Canada only.

AccountNumber.description: Account number - required for associating the bank details.

ABARoutingNumber.description: ABA routing number - required for associating the bank details. US only.

SendEmail.description: This option is used to send the account verification initiation/expiration email. If you wish to send an email, then provide true. The default value is false.

SenderEmailAddress.description: Account's email address - Must be a valid email. Required if SendEmail = true

ReceiverEmailAddress.description: Recipient's email address - Must be a valid email. Required if SendEmail = true

PhoneNumber.description: Customer's phone number. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed. US only.

City.description: Account's city - No abbreviation. US only.

State.description: Customer's state specified using two character abbreviations (eg. CA, AZ). US only.

Token.description: The token identifying the bank account to be verified. If token is provided, bank routing info and address are not required.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the Bank Account to be verified

Link.description: Link associated with the Account Verification Request ID

post.description: This endpoint is used to confirm the micro deposit transaction.

VerificationRequestID.description: Value of the Account Verification Request ID

Amount.description: Amount to be confirmed for the Account Verification Request ID

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

post.description: This endpoint is used to verify a credit or debit card.

VerificationTier.description: Tier of the verification request. Options are 'basic' and 'enhanced'. Defaults to 'basic' if not specified.

CardToken.description: The token identifying the credit or debit card

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the Bank Account to be verified

VerificationInfo.description: Verification information for the request (enhanced only)

SendingEligibility.description: This debit card's eligibility to send funds.

ReceivingEligibility.description: This debit card's eligibility to receive funds.

FundsAvailability.description: Funds availability time frame after receiving a payment transaction.

post.description: This endpoint is used to verify an Interac email address.

VerificationTier.description: Tier of the verification request. Options are 'basic' and 'enhanced'. Defaults to 'basic' if not specified.

EmailAddress.description: Email address of the account holder

AccountHolderName.description: Name of the account holder - required for associating the email address (not required if ClientAccountID/ContactID is present)

ClientAccountID.description: Client account ID - required for associating the email address (not required if AccountHolderName is present)

ContactID.description: Contact ID - required for associating the email address (not required if AccountHolderName is present)

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the Bank Account to be verified

RegistrationInfo.description: Registration information for the verification request (enhanced only)

get.description: This endpoint is used to fetch the details of a micro deposit transaction.

parameters.name: AccountID
parameters.description: Your account ID

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: API key for the account

parameters.name: Signature
parameters.description: Hashed signature for the request

parameters.name: VerificationRequestID
parameters.description: Value of the Account Verification Request ID

parameters.name: RequestStatus
parameters.description: The account verification request status. Can be 'active' or 'expired'

parameters.name: VerificationStatus
parameters.description: The vefification status of the account. Can be 'unverified', 'verified' or 'failed'

parameters.name: VerificationType
parameters.description: The verification type. Can be 'bank' or 'interac'

parameters.name: SearchText
parameters.description: A text string to search for in the email addresses used for Account Verification process.

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Return micro deposit transactions that occurred on or after this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: Return micro deposit transactions that occurred on or before this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

parameters.name: Timezone
parameters.description: Use this parameter to convert the time to the specified timezone. If no timezone is specified, the default is UTC.

post.description: This endpoint is used to intiate an email verification.

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID associated with this email. This is required if client account is enabled. Use ContactID instead if client account is not enabled.

ContactID.description: The contact ID associated with this email. This is required if client account is not enabled. Use ClientAccountID instead if client account is enabled.

EmailAddress.description: Email address to be verified - Must be a valid email

VerificationTier.description: Tier of the verification request. Options are 'basic' and 'enhanced'. Defaults to 'basic' if not specified.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the Email to be verified

post.description: This endpoint is used to confirm an email verification using an OTP sent to the email address.

Token.description: The single-use token associated with the email verification request

OTP.description: The one-time password sent to the email address to be verified

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationStatus.description: Status of the verification. Can be 'verified' or 'failed'.

post.description: This endpoint is used to intiate an phone SMS verification.

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID associated with this phone number. This is required if client account is enabled. Use ContactID instead if client account is not enabled.

ContactID.description: The contact ID associated with this phone number. This is required if client account is not enabled. Use ClientAccountID instead if client account is enabled.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number to be verified - Must be a valid phone number

VerificationTier.description: Tier of the verification request. Options are 'basic' and 'enhanced'. Defaults to 'basic' if not specified.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the Phone to be verified

post.description: This endpoint is used to confirm a phone verification using an OTP sent via SMS.

Token.description: The single-use token associated with the phone verification request

OTP.description: The one-time password sent via SMS to the phone number to be verified

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationStatus.description: Status of the verification. Can be 'verified' or 'failed'.

post.description: This endpoint is used to perform Non-Document ID verification on an individual. Currently only Canada is supported.

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID to verify. This is required if client account is enabled. Use ContactID instead if client account is not enabled.

ContactID.description: The contact ID of the contact to verify. This is required if client account is not enabled. Use ClientAccountID instead if client account is enabled.

DOB.description: Date of Birth, in date format YYYY-MM-DD (ex: 1960-01-15).

EmailAddress.description: Email address of the contact - Must be a valid email

Province.description: Contact's province specified using two character abbreviations (eg. BC, AB)

Country.description: Contact's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

TriggerAMLCheck.description: Include an AML check if the dual process verification status is verified.

TriggerManualIDVOnFailure.description: If the non-document verification status is not verified then initiate a manual ID verification request to the email provided above.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the contact to be verified

post.description: This endpoint generates an embed URL for contact verification. The URL can be used to embed a verification iframe for address, basic ID, or enhanced ID verification.

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID to generate the embed URL for. This is required if client account is enabled. Use ContactID instead if client account is not enabled.

ContactID.description: The contact ID to generate the embed URL for. This is required if client account is not enabled. Use ClientAccountID instead if client account is enabled.

VerificationType.description: The type(s) of verification to embed. Must be one or more of: 'address', 'idbasic', 'idenhanced'. Multiple values can be comma-separated.

StylesheetUrl.description: URL of a custom stylesheet to apply to the embedded verification iframe

Language.description: The language preference for the embed. Defaults to 'en'.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

SingleUseToken.description: Single-use token used to generate the embed URL

post.description: This endpoint is used to verify contacts name

ClientAccountID.description: The client account ID associated with this name. This is required if client account is enabled. Use ContactID instead if client account is not enabled.

ContactID.description: The contact ID associated with this name. This is required if client account is not enabled. Use ClientAccountID instead if client account is enabled.

Country.description: Contact's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

VerificationRequestID.description: Verification Request ID for the contact name screening request
